errors.evidence: The chart's y-axis unit is "句对数/s" (sentence pairs per second), which is a unit of speed/throughput. The description incorrectly states the unit is "秒" (seconds), which is a unit of time. Speed cannot be measured in units of time alone.
The last category on the x-axis is labeled "15-16", not "16-20".
The y-axis label is "句对数/s" (sentence pairs per second), which represents processing speed, not "预测耗时" (prediction time consumed).
The value reported is incorrect due to the wrong unit. The chart shows a speed of 3516 sentence pairs per second, not a time of 3516 seconds. This error is repeated for all reported data points.
